text: これも　わたして　おくから　もっと　もっと　がんばって　くれ！

structure.jp: これも　わたして　おくから
structure.en: I'll give you these too, so

structure.jp: もっと　もっと　がんばって　くれ！

patterns.name: 〜ておく
patterns.explanation: おく after a て-form verb says you do it now so it is ready for later. わたして　おく = 'I'll hand them over (so you have them)'.

patterns.name: 〜から
patterns.span: わたして　おくから
patterns.explanation: から after a sentence gives the reason for what comes next, like 'so'. わたして　おくから = 'I'll hand them over, so'.

patterns.name: 〜てくれ
patterns.explanation: くれ after a て-form verb is a blunt way to ask someone to do something for you. がんばって　くれ = 'do your best (for me)'.
